:::{#def-maximal-probability-of-error}
#### Maximal probability of error

The **maximal probability of error** $\lambda^{(n)}$
of an $(M, n)$ [channel code](#def-channel-code)
is the largest, over messages $w$,
of the [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) that the decoder's guess is wrong when $w$ is sent.
This is the definition of @cover2006elements [section 7.5].

:::
